headline: Colombia Charges Starlink and Local Operators Over Prison Signal Restrictions
summary: Colombia's ICT Ministry opened formal charges against SpaceX's Starlink and local telecom operators for alleged failure to comply with mandatory signal blocking requirements in Colombian prisons.
why: Starlink provides low-Earth orbit satellite broadband internet services globally, including expanding connectivity across Latin America.

impacts.name: Starlink / SpaceX
impacts.why: Formal administrative charges by Colombia's telecom regulator create compliance penalties.
